snippet.title: Le Concert ff (PS1)  Full Playthrough + True Ending | No Commentary
snippet.description:
One of the first rhythm games created - released in 1999 for the PS1. Gameplay is you're a conductor of an orchestra and you que musicians to play their part by using the d-pad; hit the corresponding notes with face or L&R buttons. This is Japanese only and I had the dialogue auto translated but it still was hard to understand. True ending (stage 6) was unlocked after 10 A ranks.
